subsystems.name: Sensing layer
subsystems.role: watches the city second by second — power flows, traffic, weather, building demand.

subsystems.name: Neuromorphic compute layer
subsystems.role: processes sensor events as spikes, the way neurons do, using very little power.

subsystems.name: Learning and control layer
subsystems.role: turns spike patterns into decisions: when to shift load, which route to open.
parts: local learning rules such as spike-timing-dependent plasticity

subsystems.name: Actuation layer
subsystems.role: the muscles — physical devices that actually change the flow of energy and vehicles.

subsystems.name: Communications and time sync
subsystems.role: keeps thousands of nodes agreeing on the same picture of the city.

subsystems.name: Safety and fallback
subsystems.role: ensures that if the learned controller misbehaves, the city does not black out.

buildSteps.title: Instrument a district
buildSteps.detail: Install meters, phasor measurement units and traffic sensors so every important node reports its state at high rate.

buildSteps.title: Build the digital twin
buildSteps.detail: Model the electricity network and road network together in simulation, calibrated against real measurements.

buildSteps.title: Encode the data as spikes
buildSteps.detail: Convert continuous measurements into event streams — a spike when a value crosses a threshold or changes fast — which is what neuromorphic chips consume efficiently.

buildSteps.title: Train the spiking network
buildSteps.detail: Use surrogate-gradient or local learning rules to teach the network to forecast load and congestion, rewarding it for keeping supply and traffic flowing.

buildSteps.title: Map onto neuromorphic hardware
buildSteps.detail: Compile the trained network onto neuron cores, placing heavily connected neurons close together to cut communication.

buildSteps.title: Wrap it in a supervisory layer
buildSteps.detail: Connect the neuromorphic controller to existing SCADA and traffic management systems so it advises or supervises, rather than directly driving breakers.

buildSteps.title: Pilot closed-loop on one feeder and one corridor
buildSteps.detail: Let the system actually act on a small area under human supervision and with classical controllers ready to take over.

buildSteps.title: Verify, harden and scale
buildSteps.detail: Prove safety and cyber-security, then extend node by node across the city, keeping a classical fallback at every level.

prerequisites.why: research chips exist and run spiking networks, but capacity, toolchains and supply for city-scale deployment do not yet.
learning methods for deep spiking networks are improving but remain less mature than ordinary deep learning.

prerequisites.tech: Real-time sensing of grid and traffic
prerequisites.why: smart meters, phasor measurement units and traffic detectors already provide much of the raw data, though coverage is uneven.
control decisions in milliseconds need deterministic links that public networks do not always guarantee.
no established route exists to certify a continuously learning controller for critical infrastructure.
power and transport are usually modelled separately; a joint twin is needed to train and test the controller.

pathway.milestone: Laboratory demonstrations of spiking networks for load forecasting and traffic signal timing
pathway.unlocks: evidence that event-driven control can match conventional methods at lower energy.

pathway.milestone: Advisory pilot on a campus microgrid and a small traffic network
pathway.unlocks: trust, data and interfaces with real utility and city systems.

pathway.milestone: Closed-loop control of a single distribution feeder and adjacent signal corridor
pathway.unlocks: proof that learned, spike-based control is safe alongside classical automation.

pathway.milestone: District-scale coordination of power, transport and heating with human oversight
pathway.unlocks: measurable resilience gains — faster rerouting after faults or accidents.
urban systems that absorb shocks and recover without central command, if certification and security are solved.
